Definition: to loosen; by implication, to expose, dismiss; figuratively, absolve, begin
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lead, act as leader; 2) to let go, let loose, ignore, let alone; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to let go, let loose; 2a2) to let alone, avoid, neglect; 2a3) to loosen; 2b) (Niphal) to be let loose, be loosened of restraint; 2c) (Hiphil); 2c1) to cause to refrain; 2c2) to show lack of restraint; 2c3) to let loose restraints
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
